Name: Pretty Anime Portraits
Author: SerDakota
Description:
[b]These are Ai Generated!

[/b]Yo, welcome to my Portrait mod. Please be aware that this mod is borderline NSFW for the most part. The female characters all have some combination of visible areola, hard nipples, or visible panties in their shots. The NSFW shop portraits are obviously NSFW. Shocking I know.

[b]STOP ASKING ABOUT SVE! ITS REALLY ANNOYING AND I DONT HAVE PERMISSION!! IF I HAD PERMISSION IT WOULD OF BEEN RELEASED ALREADY. SAME GOES FOR RIDGESIDE![/b]

I appreciate y'all wanting them and I wish I could do it but as it stands I cant. Not without a way to replace the sprites which I dont currently have the money for and even if I did its not a certainty it wouldnt get removed anyways. If someone wants to donate and gamble their money info on the Discord.

On my Discord I don't mind helping you to make your own portraits for them for your own personal use but that's about all I can do publicly.

[b]A few notes:[/b]

Beach Bikini support will increase load times on both versions going to and leaving the beach. At this time I dont think I can get around that due to portrait size. 

All optional and Misc files are only compatible with the 1024x version. I will not be changing this.

There are a number of Misc files that do various things. Some need to be installed manually by coping and pasting them into the correct folder. If you can download it with Vortex then you just do that and load it after whatever its asking to override. 

[b]Installation Instructions: [/b]

[b]Manual:[/b] Download them and place in your mod folder. Any optional mods you want to add do the same and just override them.

[b]Vortex:[/b] Its even easier you just download them. If you want to add something optional then download it with Vortex as well and load it AFTER the main mod when asked to solve the conflict.

ONLY COMPATABLE WITH 1024X VERSION. NOT included in All in One.
